razonamiento: The architecture is reconstructed from the 7 drawn boxes and matching narration. Two Lambda functions and two RDS / Kinesis icons appear on the board, representing distinct steps in the ingestion, batching, rule processing, and output pipeline. CI/CD tooling (Jenkins, CloudFormation) mentioned in the narration is omitted as it represents deployment rather than runtime architecture.

nodes.name: Lambda
nodes.notes: Lean and fast function to fetch transactions and batch

nodes.name: RDS
nodes.notes: Stores user transactions queried by Lambda

nodes.name: Lambda
nodes.notes: Executes compiled Antler rules on transaction batches

edges.notes: Kinesis stream event triggers first Lambda
edges.respaldo: line b0->b1; 'there'll be an event here published on the Kinesis stream'

edges.notes: SQL query to fetch user transactions
edges.respaldo: line b1->b2; 'So that's going to do a SQL query to RDS to say, give me the transactions'

edges.notes: Batches transactions and publishes messages to SQS queue
edges.respaldo: line b1->b3; 'gathering those up into batches of say a hundred and then publishing a new message to SQS'
line b3->b4; 'So it's going to hit the SQS queue. And I see we've got Lambda here.'
line b4->b5; 'So you're writing that to RDS, are you? Yes.'

edges.notes: Publishes results to outbound Kinesis stream
edges.respaldo: line b4->b6; 'Is this where you're going to publish the results or is that a, what is that? Is that an event stream or? Yeah.'
